'''Stay conscious''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to remain conscious when suffering an injury that would normally cause them to lapse into unconsciousness.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[block pain]] spell.
